springSecurity.checkMatchers.title: Warn about Java/Kotlin matcher ordering and duplicate/unreachable Security XML patterns

springSecurity.checkPathPatterns.title: Check explicit PathPatternRequestMatcher factory path syntax (implicit matcher strategy stays unresolved)

springSecurity.checkDebug.title: Warn when security debug logging is enabled (@EnableWebSecurity(debug = true), WebSecurity.debug(true), <debug/>)

springSecurity.checkBeanReferences.title: Report bean references no bean answers
springSecurity.checkBeanReferences.description: Report bean references (userDetailsServiceBeanName, @bean in security expressions, ref attributes of the security namespace) that no bean of the project answers (Info)

springSecurity.checkSelfInvocation.title: Warn about calls to secured methods in the same class
springSecurity.checkSelfInvocation.description: Warn when a method protected by @PreAuthorize, @PostAuthorize, @PreFilter or @PostFilter is called from the same class (skips the proxy; wrong when method security uses AspectJ mode)

springSecurity.matcherHover.title: Show hover for matcher declarations
springSecurity.matcherHover.description: Show source hover for explicit known matcher declarations

springSecurity.matcherInlays.title: Show source inlays for explicit known matcher declarations

springSecurity.checkMigration.title: Warn about removed Spring Security 6 APIs
springSecurity.checkMigration.description: Warn about source declarations of removed or deprecated Security configuration APIs (source advisories, framework version unresolved)

springSecurity.checkRolePrefixes.title: Warn about explicit ROLE_ prefixes in role-check literals (receiver and custom prefix semantics unresolved)

springSecurity.checkPasswords.title: Warn about source declarations of NoOpPasswordEncoder and {noop} passwords

springSecurity.checkExpressions.title: Check access expression syntax
springSecurity.checkExpressions.description: Check source-local Security XML access expression syntax and known function names (custom expression roots unresolved)

springSecurity.checkXmlAttributes.title: Check supported Security XML required attributes and known enumerated values
